suspense.en: The mystery novel builds suspense before revealing the final clue.
suspense.zh: 這本推理小說在揭曉最後線索前營造懸念。

suspension.en: The bridge uses a suspension design across the wide river.
suspension.zh: 這座橋採用懸吊式設計跨越寬廣河面。

suspicion.en: His sudden change in behavior raised suspicion among the group.
suspicion.zh: 他突然改變行為，引起了小組的懷疑。

suspicious.en: The teacher found the repeated identical answers suspicious.
suspicious.zh: 老師覺得反覆出現完全相同的答案很可疑。

sustainable.en: The project focuses on sustainable ways to reduce school waste.
sustainable.zh: 這項專題著重於永續減少校園垃圾的方法。

swallow.en: A swallow flew across the field just before sunset.
swallow.zh: 日落前，一隻燕子飛過田野。

swamp.en: The wetland trail passes beside a large swamp area.
swamp.zh: 濕地步道經過一大片沼澤區。

swan.en: A white swan moved slowly across the quiet lake.
swan.zh: 一隻白天鵝緩緩游過安靜的湖面。

swap.en: The students agreed to swap seats for the group activity.
swap.zh: 學生同意為小組活動交換座位。

swarm.en: A swarm of bees gathered near the flowering tree.
swarm.zh: 一群蜜蜂聚集在開花的樹附近。

sway.en: The tall grass began to sway in the evening wind.
sway.zh: 高草在晚風中開始搖曳。

swear.en: He had to swear that his statement was truthful.
swear.zh: 他必須宣誓自己的陳述是真實的。

sweat.en: Sweat helps the body cool down during physical activity.
sweat.zh: 運動時流汗有助於身體降溫。

sweater.en: She brought a sweater because the classroom felt cold.
sweater.zh: 因為教室很冷，她帶了一件毛衣。

sweep.en: Volunteers stayed after the event to sweep the floor.
sweep.zh: 活動結束後，志工留下來掃地。

sweet.en: The ripe mango had a naturally sweet flavor.
sweet.zh: 成熟芒果帶有天然的甜味。

swell.en: The river began to swell after several days of rain.
swell.zh: 連續下雨數日後，河水開始上漲。

swift.en: The committee made a swift decision after reviewing the evidence.
swift.zh: 委員會審查證據後迅速做出決定。

swim.en: Students can swim only during supervised pool sessions.
swim.zh: 學生只能在有人監督的泳池時段游泳。

swimsuit.en: She packed a swimsuit for the school swimming lesson.
swimsuit.zh: 她為學校游泳課帶了泳衣。

swing.en: The empty swing moved gently in the afternoon breeze.
swing.zh: 空蕩的鞦韆在午後微風中輕輕擺動。

switch.en: Press the switch to turn on the classroom projector.
switch.zh: 按下開關即可開啟教室投影機。

syllable.en: The teacher asked us to clap once for each syllable.
syllable.zh: 老師要我們每個音節拍一次手。

symbolic.en: The dove has symbolic meaning in many works of art.
symbolic.zh: 鴿子在許多藝術作品中具有象徵意義。

symbolize.en: In the poem, changing seasons symbolize the passage of time.
symbolize.zh: 在這首詩裡，季節變化象徵時間流逝。

symmetry.en: The butterfly's wings show clear symmetry in their pattern.
symmetry.zh: 蝴蝶翅膀的圖案呈現明顯對稱。

sympathetic.en: The teacher was sympathetic when the student explained the problem.
sympathetic.zh: 學生說明問題後，老師表示理解與同情。

sympathize.en: It is easy to sympathize with someone facing a difficult situation.
sympathize.zh: 面對困難處境的人很容易讓人產生同理心。

sympathy.en: The class sent a card expressing sympathy to the family.
sympathy.zh: 班上寄出卡片向那個家庭表達慰問。

symphony.en: The orchestra performed a famous symphony at the concert hall.
symphony.zh: 管弦樂團在音樂廳演奏了一首著名交響曲。

synonym.en: The dictionary lists a synonym beside the unfamiliar word.
synonym.zh: 字典在這個陌生單字旁列出一個同義詞。

synthetic.en: The experiment compares natural fibers with synthetic materials.
synthetic.zh: 實驗比較天然纖維與合成材料。

syrup.en: She poured a little syrup over the pancakes at breakfast.
syrup.zh: 早餐時，她在鬆餅上淋了一點糖漿。

systematic.en: A systematic review helped the group organize its research notes.
systematic.zh: 有系統的複習幫助小組整理研究筆記。

t-shirt.en: He wore a school t-shirt during the sports day event.
t-shirt.zh: 運動會時他穿著學校的 T 恤。

tablet.en: Students used a tablet to record observations during the field trip.
tablet.zh: 學生在校外教學時使用平板記錄觀察結果。

tackle.en: The team met after class to tackle the hardest problem together.
tackle.zh: 小組放學後一起處理最困難的問題。

tactic.en: Changing the order of questions was a useful test tactic.
tactic.zh: 改變答題順序是一個實用的考試策略。

tag.en: Each bag has a tag showing the owner's name.
tag.zh: 每個袋子都有標籤寫著主人的名字。

tail.en: The dog wagged its tail when the students approached.
tail.zh: 學生靠近時，那隻狗搖了搖尾巴。

tailor.en: The tailor adjusted the jacket so it fit more comfortably.
tailor.zh: 裁縫調整了外套，讓穿著更舒適。

tale.en: The teacher read a traditional tale from the local region.
tale.zh: 老師讀了一則當地的傳統故事。

talent.en: The festival gave students a chance to show their talent.
talent.zh: 校慶讓學生有機會展現才華。

talkative.en: The talkative student became quiet once the test began.
talkative.zh: 那位健談的學生一開始考試就安靜下來。

tall.en: A tall tree provides shade beside the playground.
tall.zh: 操場旁有一棵高大的樹提供遮蔭。

tame.en: The rescued bird remained calm because it had become tame.
tame.zh: 那隻獲救的鳥因已被馴養而保持平靜。

tangerine.en: She packed a tangerine in her lunch box today.
tangerine.zh: 她今天在午餐盒裡放了一顆橘子。

tangle.en: The cables formed a tangle behind the computer desk.
tangle.zh: 電腦桌後方的電線纏成一團。

tank.en: The aquarium tank contains several colorful tropical fish.
tank.zh: 水族箱裡有幾條色彩鮮豔的熱帶魚。

tap.en: Give the screen a light tap to open the menu.
tap.zh: 輕點螢幕即可開啟選單。
